rounds.text: Amines & Plasticizers Ltd demonstrates an attractive core return profile, evidenced by a solid ROCE of 16.7% and an ROE of 13.3% [E6, E7]. The long-term earnings track record highlights exceptional wealth creation potential, showing a compounded profit growth of 15% over 10 years and accelerating momentum with 17% compounded profit growth over 3 years [E12, E14]. Recent operational indicators further support this positive thesis, as the company displays sales up quarter-on-quarter alongside accelerating earnings growth [E58, E59]. Conceded: the company has delivered a poor sales growth of 5.26% over the past five years alongside a trailing twelve-month profit contraction of -11% [E13, E15, E53]. Nevertheless, the market capitalisation sits at a modest ₹ 1,077 Cr while resting comfortably in the middle of its 52-week range [E3, E5], leaving plenty of room for appreciation as its multi-year earnings acceleration takes hold [E14, E59].
